tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Should enclose certificate of registration issued by Labour Dept., GOK.

Should enclose a copy of Authorization from the Company for signing the Tender Documents and to deal in this business with signature attestation by the Managing Director/Director if it is Public or Private Limited Company.
Should enclose Annual Accounts certified by Chartered Accountants, IT Returns, GST and PAN Card copy enclosed for Assessment Years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 certified by the Chartered Accountants.
Should enclose a business performance Certificate for last 3 years obtained from the clients indicating personnel engaged, Quality and timely supply of man power.
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily executed at least two orders, which should be supported by the scanned copies of Service Reports enclosed to the Technical bid.
The Tenderer should be a holder of valid Labour License and ISO 9001:2000 and other certificates certified by the authorized Agencies.

The Tenderer should enclose the scanned copies of registration certificate of Service Tax/Income Tax/GST/ Professional Tax/and EPF and ESI Income-tax and Service Tax Statements submitted to the concerned authorities in the last 03 years to the Technical bid.
The Tenderer should enclose along with the Technical bid the performance certificate of last 3 years issued by the Govt. Department/Public undertaking etc.
Any other documents required as per tender conditions
